question: Which city is known as the ‘Silicon Plateau’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Silicon Plateau **of India is the nickname of **Bengaluru**.
 
• It is called so because Bengaluru has grown as a hub for the **semiconductor Industry**.
 
• **Bengaluru** is located in** Karnataka**.</li&
